title: Total Qty sort orders tracked parts by quantity, negative first, then ties and untracked parts by description
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Active tab of /parts/inventory, search cleared, Supply All, DevTools Network open. Data: tracked negative-bin parts QAPL-N1 (+5/−2), N2 (−2 only), N3 (+5/−5), N4 (+2.5/−1.25), N5 (+3/+2/−9994); QAPL-T1…T5 (tracked); QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 (untracked). Known mismatch (don't file): Total Qty sorts by the stored part quantity while the cell shows the bins' available quantity, so a part whose stored quantity disagrees with its bins can look out of order; judge the order against the quantity in the GET /api/inventory/parts rows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Total Qty column header to sort ascending; read the first rows and the matching GET /api/inventory/parts response (sortBy=quantity, descending=false).
  2. Find a group of tracked parts with the same quantity (e.g. the parts at 0).
  3. Scroll to the end of the list (infinite scroll).
  4. Click Total Qty again to sort descending; read the first rows.
  5. Scroll to the end of the list.
  6. Search QAPL-N with the ascending Total Qty sort.
custom_expected:
1. Tracked parts with negative stock come first, lowest quantity first, then the tracked parts in rising quantity.
  2. Within the group, parts are ordered by description A–Z.
  3. The last rows are the untracked parts (QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 and any other active untracked part), each "Not Tracked", ordered by description A–Z; no tracked part follows them and no row repeats.
  4. Tracked parts highest quantity first.
  5. The untracked parts are still the last rows, still A–Z by description.
  6. QAPL-N1…N5 are listed in the order of their stored quantity from the API, lowest first, with the negative-stock parts at the top.
